name: Data centre medium-voltage switchgear
description: The MV layer that takes utility or on-site generation supply into a data-centre campus and splits it to transformers and UPS halls: air-insulated (AIS) for flexible, expandable rooms and gas-insulated (GIS) where footprint or harsh conditions rule. ABB's MV switchgear covers 1-52 kV under IEC to IEC 62271, with SF6-free insulation (dry air or natural-origin gases, GWP below 1) available for most 6-24 kV applications and compliant with EU F-gas regulation 2024/573; data centres are a named served industry.

subtypes.name: Air-insulated switchgear (AIS)
subtypes.description: Modular withdrawable panels, easy to extend in an assembled room; the default for accessible plant rooms.

subtypes.name: Gas-insulated switchgear (GIS)
subtypes.description: Compact sealed tank design for constrained or harsh sites; SF6 or SF6-free (dry-air / natural-origin gas).

subtypes.name: SF6-free GIS
subtypes.description: Same interface and footprint as SF6 versions, GWP below 1, compliant with EU F-gas regulation 2024/573.

specifications.basis: 1 kV to 52 kV according to IEC standards (vendor range statement); standards compliance to IEC 62271
